text:
Type: woven banana fibre pouffe
Use: low seat, footrest, floor seating; living room, bedroom, reading corner
Style: bohemian, coastal, rustic
Materials: hand-braided banana fibre, natural plaited texture
Colors: warm greige, sandy brown, muted grey
Shape: low round puck shape with a slightly domed top and rounded sides, tight spiral braiding, compact but solid
Feel: earthy, relaxed, natural, cozy
Goes with: light wood, linen, jute rugs, green plants; bohemian, coastal or rustic living rooms
